has_secret.description: Whether a client secret is stored. The secret itself is never returned.

secret.description: Write-only. Omit to leave the stored secret unchanged; send an empty string to clear it. It is never returned by any read.

effective_value.description: The value the running processes resolve today, which is the stored row only when one exists.

env_var.description: Environment variable consulted when no row is stored; may be empty.

settings_attr.description: Settings attribute consulted after the environment; may be empty.

value.description: One public-safe line; the server trims Unicode whitespace and rejects markup and control characters.
